# cloudtower_vm_folder (Data Source)

CloudTower vm folder data source.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) filter vm folder by cluster id.
- `cluster_id_in` (List of String) filter vm folder by cluster id in list.
- `name` (String) filter vm folder by name.
- `name_contains` (String) filter vm folder by name contains.
- `name_in` (List of String) filter vm folder by name in list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
